description: Affordable mid-century 2 BR, 1 BA ranch with cottage charm in Montclair's desirable Merriwood neighborhood. This 1151 sq  ft, single-level home offers original character, a functional floor plan and tremendous potential for customization to make it your own. The house enjoys solid construction, large picture windows in the living room provide abundant natural light & architectural appeal. A double-sided woodburning fireplace in the living room/dining area gives the space a warm focal point. A period chandelier in the dining area adds vintage charm. Hardwood floors in both bedrooms.
